task_prompt: Write a function to find kth element from the given two sorted arrays.
final_code:
def find_kth(arr1, arr2, k):
    m = len(arr1)
    n = len(arr2)
    sorted1 = [0] * (m + n)
    i = 0
    j = 0
    d = 0
    while (i < m and j < n):
        if (arr1[i] < arr2[j]):
            sorted1[d] = arr1[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            sorted1[d] = arr2[j]
            j += 1
        d += 1
    while (i < m):
        sorted1[d] = arr1[i]
        d += 1
        i += 1
    while (j < n):
        sorted1[d] = arr2[j]
        d += 1
        j += 1
    return sorted1[k - 1]
